Get Territorial Mobility and Commuting Flows of Peru

Source: R/get_flujos_movilidad.R
get_flujos_movilidad.Rd

Downloads and loads spatial flow lines of inter-district commuting and mobility patterns for students and workers in Peru, modeled by SDOT-PCM. Available across multiple flow volume brackets (e.g. 100-1000, 1000-3500, etc.).

Usage

get_flujos_movilidad(
  tipo = NULL,
  volumen = NULL,
  departamento = NULL,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  force_update = FALSE,
  ...
)

get_flujos_estudiantes(volumen = "100_1000", ...)

get_flujos_trabajadores(volumen = "100_1500", ...)

Arguments

tipo

Character. Type of mobility flow:

  • "estudiantes" (or "est"): Student commuting flows.

  • "trabajadores" (or "trb"): Worker commuting flows.

Case-insensitive. If NULL, lists available types and volume intervals.

volumen

Character or numeric. Volume interval bracket:

  • For students: "100_1000" (default), "1000_3500", "3500_7000", "7000_13000", "13000".

  • For workers: "100_1500" (default), "1500_5000", "5000_10000", "10000_25000", "25000".

departamento

Character vector. Name(s) of department(s) to filter. Optional.

show_progress

Logical. If TRUE (default), shows informative messages.

force_update

Logical. If TRUE, forces a new download of files. Default FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to internal filtering functions.

Value

An sf (simple feature) object with LINESTRING geometries representing mobility vectors.

Details

Cache is stored under tools::R_user_dir("rsdot", which = "cache")/flujos_movilidad/.

See also

get_red_vial_nacional, get_tiempos_desplazamiento

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# List available options
get_flujos_movilidad()

# Load student flows between 100 and 1,000 trips
flujos_est <- get_flujos_estudiantes(volumen = "100_1000")

# Load worker flows
flujos_trb <- get_flujos_trabajadores(volumen = "100_1500")
} # }
